settings.subtitle: Train Smart. Stay Safe.
settings.title: Protective Gear Checklist
settings.text:
The right gear keeps you protected and performing your best. When choosing your equipment, consider materials, comfort, fit, and protection level — because safety should never be an afterthought:

  1. What materials were used to build this gear?
  2. What standout protective features does this model provide?
  3. How simple is it to clean and care for?
  4. Does it deliver a snug yet flexible fit for easy movement?
  5. Does a lower price mean sacrificing protection or quality?
  6. Are you investing in genuine performance, or mainly paying for the brand name?

settings.title: Polyurethane Sponge Foam
settings.text:
Polyurethane sponge foam is a high-performance material specifically crafted for demanding applications you'll need for your judo and martial arts mats.

  • Resilience and Elasticity: With its high resilience, the foam compresses under pressure and quickly returns to its original shape. This elasticity ensures consistent support and comfort, even during rigorous judo practice.

  • Exceptional Shock Absorption: Its ability to disperse impact energy minimizes injuries during throws and falls, providing a safe training environment for judo practitioners.

  • Moisture-Resistant: Designed to resist moisture, the foam prevents water absorption and the growth of mold, ensuring long-lasting durability even in humid training environments.

settings.title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Foam
settings.text:
Crosslinked polyethylene foam is a premium material engineered known for its exceptional durability, impact resistance, and firm support. Choosing this material provides a stable and secure surface, ensuring safety and comfort during rigorous training and practice sessions.

  • Superior Impact Protection: Designed to absorb and disperse energy efficiently, the foam provides excellent cushioning, reducing the risk of injury during throws and falls.

  • Waterproof and Long-Lasting: The closed-cell structure of the foam ensures it resists water and moisture, making it durable for intense judo practice sessions.

  • Reliable Under Pressure: Resistant to wear and tear, the foam maintains its integrity even under rigorous use, ensuring consistent performance for judo training.

settings.title: What makes these Tatami Mats IJF approved?
settings.text: These mats are certified by the International Judo Federation (IJF), ensuring they meet the highest standards for quality, safety, and performance. Designed for both professional competition and training, they provide excellent cushioning, grip, and stability to support athletes during high-intensity matches.

settings.title: Are these mats suitable for both judo and other martial arts?
settings.text: Yes, the IJF Approved Tatami Mats are versatile and designed for a range of martial arts, including judo, grappling, and other combat sports. With their multi-layer construction and anti-slip surface, these mats deliver the necessary shock absorption and support for various techniques and training styles.

settings.title: What are the material options for these mats?
settings.text: The mats come with two material options for optimal performance: XPE foam (crosslinked polyethylene) for firmer support, or PU (Polyurethane) for softer cushioning. Both options are paired with a durable vinyl surface featuring a rice pattern texture for enhanced grip and safety.
